relations.zotero_refs: Author reported for instance (ID:4475) in [8H6M69W4], No. 18248: gro lung pa blo gros 'byung gnas.

comments:
Explanation of the meaning of the Pañcaviṃśatisāhasrikā Prajñāpāramitā (ID:3691) together with Āryavimuktisena's commentary (ID:3707) or (ID:5935), relying on rNgog Blo ldan shes rab (ID:3786)'s explanations (gsung sgros), written as a memorandum. rNgog Blo ldan shes rab is also named - as 'lo tsha', 'lo tsha ba chen po', etc.) - over 30 times in glosses in instance (ID:4475).
The author also cites Haribhadra's Abhisamayālaṇkārālokā (ID:3709) and refers as well to "rje btsun," probably Bhadantavimuktisena (ID:5548).

This work may correspond to the commentary listed in A khu ching Shes rab rgya mtsho's Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 529, No. 11492: gro lung pa'i nyi khri'i 'grel pa).
